main:
Considered answers,
before you begin.

General Information 11 Questions Consultation & Fees 16 Questions
General Information

Understanding our approach

Our approach is rooted in clinical excellence and extensive expertise in traditional medicine, enhanced by the latest research in functional medicine. We treat all individuals aged 18 and above, regardless of gender.

While terms like functional, integrative and longevity medicine can sound like buzzwords, our approach is focused on identifying and treating the root causes of illness rather than simply managing symptoms. We emphasise personalised care, prevention and optimising long-term health.

Yes. A blood test is required before the initial consultation. We partner with The Doctors Laboratory (TDL) in Wimpole Street, London, but you can use another laboratory if preferred. Once payment is received, we send the blood test request form.

No. A GP referral is not required. However, we encourage communication with your GP where appropriate so they have a complete picture of your health.

Generally, no. Most insurers do not cover hormonal or menopause-related treatments.

Some medications (particularly for menopause and PMOS) may be prescribed by your GP following a recommendation from the clinic. Other medications require a private prescription through one of our regulated partner pharmacies, with patients responsible for the cost. Prescriptions are provided via the online portal.

We primarily prescribe licensed body-identical (bio-identical) hormones that are chemically identical to those naturally produced by the body. Where clinically appropriate, compounded hormone treatments may also be considered for patients with specific needs.

Yes, in many cases. These are often referred to as body-identical hormones within the NHS. However, we recommend a consultation to determine the most suitable treatment based on each individual’s circumstances.

Results vary between individuals. Some patients notice improvements sooner, but the full benefits of hormone replacement therapy can take up to three months.

Yes. While compounded hormone formulations themselves are not licensed in the same way as mass-produced medicines, the individual hormones are licensed and regulated. Compounded HRT is prepared by MHRA-regulated pharmacies under strict quality standards.

Appointments can be booked online via our booking platform. Patients complete an initial questionnaire, after which a member of the team contacts them to discuss the next steps.

After submitting the questionnaire, we will contact you to arrange your consultation. Blood tests are required before the first appointment, and international patients are also welcome, with consultations available by phone or video.

Consultation & Diagnostic Fees

Appointments, testing & fees

Time, attention and expertise, priced with clarity. Below you will find consultation fees and answers to practical questions about booking, preparation and follow-up.

A 60-minute video or phone consultation with Dr Gina Schoeman. This comprehensive review includes a full medical history, symptom discussion, lifestyle and nutritional guidance, and a personalised investigation plan.

£500

A 30-minute video or phone consultation to review progress, monitor treatment response and adjust prescriptions as needed.

£250

Blood tests are required before your initial consultation. We partner with The Doctors Laboratory (TDL) in Wimpole Street, London, and issue the request form once payment has been received. You may use another laboratory if preferred.

Additional investigations may include pelvic ultrasound, mammograms, or specialist functional medicine laboratory testing. These are recommended only when clinically relevant and are charged separately.

Please ensure you:

  • Use the video link provided in your confirmation email.
  • Are in a quiet, private location.
  • Have a charged device with camera and microphone.
  • Have a stable internet connection.
  • Join a few minutes early to test the connection.

Before your appointment:

  • Submit your blood results at least 48 hours in advance as a PDF.
  • Results must include your full name, date of birth, sample date and laboratory details.
  • Post-menopausal patients can test at any time; menstruating patients should test on days 18–22 of their cycle.

Complete the online patient questionnaire and a member of our team will contact you to discuss next steps and arrange your consultation.

Appointments are booked online through our secure platform. Once your registration is complete, you will receive confirmation and a link to join your video consultation.

International patients are welcome. However:

  • Consultations are remote.
  • Local restrictions may affect blood testing or medication delivery.
  • Patients must have a UK address for prescribed medication.
  • Please contact the clinic before booking.

International consultations are available by phone or video. Patients should have a UK address for prescriptions and contact the Patient Care Team before booking.

The clinic primarily operates online via secure video consultations. If clinically appropriate, appointments may also be arranged on Harley Street or in Wimbledon.

  • Walk-ins are not accepted.
  • Photo ID is required.
  • A patient portal is planned for future release.

The clinic primarily operates as a virtual clinic. In-person appointments may be arranged on Harley Street or in Wimbledon only when clinically appropriate.

No GP referral is required. We do, however, encourage communication with your GP where appropriate to ensure continuity of care.

Some medications can be prescribed by your GP following our recommendation. Others require a private prescription through our regulated partner pharmacies.

  • Standard prescriptions are valid for 6 months.
  • Controlled medications (e.g. testosterone, DHEA) are valid for 28 days.
  • Minimum two working days’ notice is required.
  • Late cancellations incur the full fee.
  • Office hours are Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm.

We require a minimum of two working days’ notice to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations or missed appointments will be charged the full consultation fee.

Begin a conversation
in confidence.

Introductions are handled personally by our patient office. Every enquiry is received with complete discretion and answered within one working day.
